name: prop-car
about: Nest Egg Run's car (second version, after the final review found the first one's buttressed tail too close to a famous Italian coupe): a compact future city car with a wraparound dark canopy, a flat rear hatch with a magenta light bar and a cyan bar across the nose. Tripo v3.1 at its standard (low-credit) settings from concept traffic-car-b-sd-0, one attempt; mirrored to exact symmetry.
